```yaml
name: Abuse Detection Cron

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 */6 * * *'  # Every 6 hours
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  detect-abuse:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
          
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
        
      - name: Run abuse detection scan
        run: |
          npx tsx scripts/detect-abuse.ts \
            --last 24h \
            --parallel 3 \
            --auto-apply
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
          
      - name: Commit and push changes
        uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
        with:
          message: 'chore: update abuse detection results'
          author_name: GitHub Actions
          author_email: actions@github.com
          push: true
          
      - name: Send Slack notification
        if: always()
        uses: tokorom/action-slack-incoming-webhook@d57bf1eb618f3dae9509afefa70d5774ad3d42bf
        with:
          text: 'Abuse detection cron job completed'
          blocks: |
            [
              {
                "type": "section",
                "text": {
                  "type": "mrkdwn",
                  "text": "Abuse detection cron job completed successfully"
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "context",
                "elements": [
                  {
                    "type": "mrkdwn",
                    "text": "Run ID: ${{ github.run_id }}"
                  }
                ]
              }
            ]
        env:
          SLACK_INCOMING_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
```
